question: CF-31 (controller finding, REC-39): at the live G-FORM pins the controller review scan and the formulation lead's per-file census disagree on accept coverage (scan F2b 3 accepts [worker-052, worker-071, worker-090] at 01:16:26; lead census F2b 0 accepts / 7 revise in lead_formulation_lifecycle_07_independent_verify.json at ~01:09-01:13). CF-31 states 'at least one method is wrong'. This task independently reproduces both methods at ONE measured instant from an immutable snapshot, enumerates the rule factors that can separate them, and reports which factor(s) account for the published difference.

review_corpus_digest_at_freeze.scope: reviews/*.json (top level, non-recursive, sorted by basename)
review_corpus_digest_at_freeze.digest_rule: sha256 over concatenation of (basename_utf8 || sha256(file_bytes)) for every file in sorted order

R_controller_scan.target_resolution: target_id | target | target_subnode, plus dict target.{target_id,target_subnode,subnode,node_id}; aliases F0/F1/F2A/F2B/F2/L0/L1 and AF-*-class ids
R_controller_scan.binding_rule: explicit top-level artifact_sha256|reviewed_sha256|sha256|cited_sha256 (or target/artifact dict sub-keys); match if pin.startswith(live[:12]) or live.startswith(pin[:12])
R_controller_scan.accept_count: distinct reviewer over admitted full accepts

S_lead_census.channel: reviews/*.json filesystem, re-read at census time
S_lead_census.target_resolution: implicit: any review whose artifact_sha256/reviewed_sha256 starts with the live hash

factors.V0_time: measurement instant: files landing between the census write (~01:09, artifact mtime 01:09) and the scan (01:16:26)
factors.V1_channel: filesystem reviews/*.json vs accepted-stream review events in research_map/events.jsonl (ingest lag / event-only records)
factors.V2_supersession: any accept ever vs latest verdict per (reviewer, target, live-pin) wins; tie broken by created_at then mtime then filename
factors.V3_flag_strict: counts_as_full_schema_verdict is not False (R) vs is True (strict; absent excluded)
factors.V4_text_scope: R minus accepts whose own JSON text matches a pre-registered full-schema-scope disclaimer
factors.V5_binding_exact: 12-hex prefix either direction (R) vs full 64-hex equality
factors.V6_independence_flag: R minus accepts carrying explicit counts_as_independent_verdict=false or counts_as_gate_accept=false

text_scope_disclaimer_regexes: not one of the two full[-_ ]schema accepts
does not substitute for a full[-_ ]schema
expected_measurements: M1: R reproduces the controller scan exactly at the frozen pins (F1 worker-052/072/075/085; F2a worker-017/072; F2b worker-052/071/090).
M2: S applied at the same instant cannot reproduce the published F2b=0; under S, F2b >= 2 distinct accepts if the accept files exist at the instant (temporal separation, V0).
M3: the published rule difference between R and S is visible at F1: worker-011's scoped accept (counts_as_full_schema_verdict=false) is excluded by R and included by S (V3).
M4: sensitivity table: for each factor V1-V6, the accept sets and the delta vs R at the same instant.
M5: per-file classification of every bound review file, with content sha256 and mtime, so the adjudicator can bind each verdict to bytes.

controls.K1: accept with counts_as_full_schema_verdict=false -> excluded by R, included by S
controls.K2: accept followed by later revise from the same reviewer/target/pin -> kept by R (no supersession), dropped by V2
controls.K3: path-target review (target_id='schemas/af_scc_c0_vacuum.yaml') with live pin -> missed by R target resolution, caught by S/pin-based resolution
controls.K4: event-only review (no file) -> missed by R/S file channel, caught by V1 events channel
controls.K5: file-only review (not ingested) -> caught by R, missed by V1 events channel
controls.K6: prose-only hash mention (no explicit pin key) -> must not bind under any method
controls.K7: target alias AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN -> must resolve to F2b under R
controls.K8: full 64-hex pin -> must bind under R and V5
controls.K9: 12-hex prefix pin -> binds under R, dropped by V5 exact binding
controls.K10: accept whose text carries a registered scope disclaimer -> kept by R, dropped by V4

decision_rule: RECONCILED if (a) R reproduces the controller scan exactly, (b) the published F2b counts differ only by measurement instant or by an enumerated factor, and (c) every control K1-K10 fires as specified. Otherwise report UNRECONCILED with the failing component and a minimal repro.
falsifier: Falsified by: (a) any frozen pin in pins_at_freeze differing from the live bytes at run time (abort, exit 3); (b) R not reproducing the controller scan counts at the frozen pins; (c) a published count that cannot be explained by V0-V6 even though the review files are byte-stable across the run; (d) any control K1-K10 not firing as pre-registered; or (e) a double run of the instrument over one snapshot yielding different report verdict fields.
authority_note: Worker measurement only. No node status, no validation_status, no gate verdict. No canonical/frozen/review byte is written by this task. reviews/ is read-only for this task.
hypothesis_on_divergence: H1: the F2b clause of CF-31 is temporal, not methodological: the lead census ran before the three accept files landed (090 01:08:56, 071 01:10:18, 052 01:11:15) and was published at 01:13 without re-measurement; the scan at 01:16:26 saw them. H2: the F1 clause is the genuine rule divergence: S (pin-only) counts the scoped worker-011 accept that R excludes (V3). Both are testable from file mtimes + content.
